attack_patterns: Low src_bytes with high dst_bytes in R2L attacks
Elevated hot indicators and root_shell flags in U2R attacks
High rerror_rate and srv_rerror_rate in brute force password guessing
Short or zero duration connections in privilege escalation
Use of flags RSTO, SF, and S3 in attack traffic
attack_sophistication_levels: Low to moderate for brute force R2L attacks
Moderate to high for stealthy U2R privilege escalation
Increasing difficulty indicated by difficulty_level metadata (0 to 18+)
mitigation_strategies: Access control and strong authentication on vulnerable services
detection_approaches: Signature-based detection using attack signatures and flags
Anomaly detection leveraging baseline profiling of error rates and connection counts
Correlation of multiple indicators such as hot, root_shell, failed logins, and error rates
Temporal analysis of connection bursts and service usage
